methodology: 24 direct real upstream requests with explicitly imported account, one sample per candidate, no tools executed or automatic retries.
Candidate fields, tools and history patched after endpoint/account shaping; literal reqwest body checked and SHA-256 recorded.

One local pre-send assertion failed during supplementary probe setup; no HTTP call occurred for that case. Corrected expected injected tools then ran the three history cases. Failed compilation of legacy probe made no HTTP requests.
No statistical testing or exact token budget measurement; HTTP acceptance alone is not claimed as support.
findings: Probe and probe accepted simultaneously and returned as distinct exact tool names with distinct marker arguments.

63 and 64-character names accepted; 65 and 128 rejected. Two varied 64-character names returned exactly. A repetitive 64-character n name returned 100 n characters, an upstream output mismatch recorded without local schema filtering.
Dot, colon and Chinese tool names rejected with Invalid tool use format. Exact duplicate tool definitions rejected with Improperly formed request.

Completed history tool results readable with or without current definitions, including a result in currentMessage. With a current definition the recalled tool was invoked; without a definition no tool call was returned.
Native enabled/budget_tokens and adaptive/budget_tokens rejected on Haiku 5.5; native display full rejected with supported enum in error.
Legacy max_thinking_length tags 24576, 30000 and NOT_A_NUMBER all returned LEGACY_OK. This does not establish tag or budget enforcement.
currentMessage.assistantResponseMessage rejected explicitly; assistant history prefix plus empty current user also rejected. These candidates provide no verified prefill mapping.
decision: Preserve exact-case tool identities; deduplicate identical exact names only. Retain rejection of conflicting exact duplicate names.
Allow 64-character ASCII tool names unchanged. Preserve reversible aliasing for longer/invalid names on measured upstream rejection.
Remove history-only tool placeholder injection; do not re-enable tools absent from caller definitions, including tool_choice none.
Remove local 24576 legacy budget clamp, preserve caller value in existing opt-in legacy controls; no claim that prompt budget is native or enforced.
Reject nonempty trailing assistant content explicitly instead of silently discarding it. Continue ignoring empty placeholders.
Retain native Haiku schema normalization and unknown display omission based on direct 400 evidence.
limits: One account/model/endpoint/region/date; one sample per candidate. No proof of universal name boundary, native prefill impossibility, or legacy prompt budget effectiveness. IDE and cross-provider reasoning replay not newly tested.
